name: walnut
title: Walnut
description: Ask Walnut from Raycast: quick answers, Tell Main, find a task. Needs Walnut running on this Mac.
author: openwalnut

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask Walnut
commands.subtitle: Walnut
commands.description: Type, then Enter to tell Main (fire and forget) or Cmd+Enter for a quick answer; matching tasks list below.

commands.name: ask-selection
commands.title: Ask Walnut About Selection
commands.subtitle: Walnut
commands.description: Bring the selected text from the app you are in, then say what to do with it.

commands.name: walnut-ai
commands.title: Walnut AI
commands.subtitle: Walnut
commands.description: A quick answer from Walnut's AI with follow-ups; Cmd+T switches to With tools (web search). Works as a fallback command: type anything in Raycast, then pick Walnut AI.

commands.name: walnut-ai-tools
commands.title: Walnut AI with Tools
commands.subtitle: Walnut
commands.description: Walnut's AI in a light agent session that searches the web and reads pages, with follow-ups. Works as a fallback command.

preferences.name: port
preferences.title: Walnut port
preferences.description: Where the local Walnut server listens
